syntheticOverrides.reason: All reviewed historical earnings judgments unavailable
Fixed as-of clock and network-isolated source replay

design.sample: Every calendar quarter-end, 2019–2025, specified before inspecting outcomes; no event selection
design.macroInputs: Archived ALFRED vintages with exact requested column dates; no latest-revision fallback
design.marketInputs: Historical market closes retrieved now, without a historical provider-publication vintage guarantee
design.entryRule: First available S&P close strictly after as-of date; then 21 or 63 further valid closing observations
design.outcome: S&P 500 price-index return and peak-to-trough closing drawdown; excludes dividends, execution costs, taxes and strategy allocation
design.tuning: No coefficient, threshold, band or date selection was fitted to these outcomes
design.cache: Independent cold production-server replay at each date; no current release proofs or curated earnings judgments

limitations: This is a partial automated model; its scores and regimes are not the complete live model and cannot calibrate full-model allocation prompts.
ALFRED dates do not guarantee intraday publication/ingestion times; data are treated as known only after the vintage date and execution waits for a later close.
Market prices are historical data retrieved now and may include later corrections/share adjustments; S&P is a price index without dividends.
The model and indicators were designed with knowledge of past crises. Historical outcomes here are not an independent out-of-sample validation.
Runtime bytes and synthetic overrides are hashed; run against a stable source tree. Drift checks are not an atomic filesystem transaction.
28 quarterly observations are small and some forward windows overlap; no confidence intervals, significance claim, or future forecast is inferred.
No live execution strategy, leverage, turnover, fees, total returns or predictive probability calibration is tested.
Unavailable inputs are excluded under existing production dependency rules, never backfilled with today's judgments or data revisions.
